acceptance.authority: One product backend service/route; no optional private deployment or Commerce requirement. Uses existing configured ledger, exact nanos and one PG transaction; signup policy preserved.

acceptance.idempotency: One globally serialized operation key fences recipient, exact amount and actor; concurrent same-key requests credit once, different recipient/amount/actor conflicts. Existing ledger account attribution/expiry checked; audit commits atomically once.
acceptance.app: Human approval persists before unresolved HTTP launch; repeated confirm deduplicates. Strict HTTP200 matching receipt required; malformed/non-200 2xx remains failed/retryable. Toast stays running through actual write and response. Same-account freshly verified admin may reconnect only persisted sending approval on reload; confirm cards never autoapprove; account/disposal fences suppress stale writes.
acceptance.releaseBoundary: Real Bun app calls actual mounted HTTP router + required PostgreSQL. The write is held before DB commit, acknowledged with editable composer, then committed response withheld; reload re-verifies admin through real GET /api/user, reuses the same key, sees one grant and one audit.
acceptance.legacy: Existing active Worker route/schema were already removed upstream; old loose controller receipt behavior deleted in this migration. Archived legacy document preserved as history.
